note: Learning objectives a teacher can practise against in Practice scenarios. Drafted by Claude for development and testing only; Addison Robertson (subject-matter expert) must rewrite them before any teacher use. Components match rubric/checklist.json so the same vocabulary runs through the review and the scenarios. search_query is what retrieval asks the research library for; it is never shown to the teacher.
